name: Pictural Story
source:
A boy wants comes to the artist city Almit to learn professional painting. In such a place he looks for a model and falls in love with her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名少年為學習專業繪畫，來到藝術之城阿爾米特。他在這裡尋找繪畫模特兒，並愛上了為自己擔任模特兒的女孩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
